scenes.text: Watch and read: Ama asks: Read: “Ama shared a mango with a friend. The other children smiled and said thank you.” Which action happened in the story?
The answer is: shared a mango with a friend. A factual answer is stated in the text.
Watch and read: For your retell practice, read: “Ama found a red ball at the playground. Ama gave it back to Kojo. The day ended happily.” Who is the main character?
The answer is: Ama. The character is the person the story is about.
